title: Elephant-Referee Model (ERM): context-rich drafting and zero-context refereeing for scientific work with AI agents
description:
ERM is an open-source plugin for AI agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor, Antigravity) that structures scientific work from research question to submission-ready manuscript around one rule about who sees what. A context-rich agent (the elephant) brainstorms and drafts with the researcher; fresh sub-agents with no memory of the conversation (the goldfish) referee the document cold across scope, comprehension, methods and statistics, evaluation protocol, claims versus evidence, reproducibility, citations and figures; the researcher decides on every finding.

ERM adapts the Elephant-Goldfish Model published by Google for software design to scientific research. It is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
